behavior: IBKR leg is not running anywhere continuous: gateway VM ibkr-gateway-prod is provisioned but stopped; blocked on a no-MFA secondary IBKR account and Secret Manager creds (ib-user/ib-password).
proof: gcloud compute instances describe ibkr-gateway-prod --project allocation-agent-service --zone us-central1-a --format='value(status)' -> TERMINATED

behavior: The TWS/IB Gateway socket has no auth or TLS; IBKR_HOST must be localhost or an SSH tunnel. Target shape co-locates engine-ibkr with ib-gateway, publishes no ports, and opens no firewall rule for 4001-4004.
proof: On the box: docker compose ps shows no published ports; gcloud firewall-rules list has no 4001-4004.

behavior: Defaults are 127.0.0.1:4002 (gateway paper), clientId 1, IBKR_PAPER=true. Compose uses socat ports 4004 paper / 4003 live; TWS is 7497/7496.
proof: python -c 'from app.config import Config; print(Config.IBKR_HOST, Config.IBKR_PORT)'

behavior: IBKR_PAPER does not choose the account; whatever the gateway is logged into is what you trade. On connect the client logs managedAccounts() (live U-prefixed, paper DU-prefixed). A 'paper' flag reaching a live account was observed.
proof: Log line 'IBKR connected ... accounts=[DU...]'; reject U-prefixed when paper intended. Stub: IBKR_PAPER=true connecting to a U-account logs it and proceeds.
notes: No code refuses a U-account when IBKR_PAPER=true.

behavior: An unreachable gateway raises ConnectionError naming host:port and docs/IBKR_GATEWAY.md. The run loop treats it as retryable (exponential backoff, capped at 5 min) and keeps writing the heartbeat.
proof: python main.py --broker ibkr status with no gateway; expect ConnectionError text. heartbeat.json consecutive_errors climbs.

behavior: ib_async is imported lazily, with an ib_insync fallback; deployments without 'ibkr' in ENABLED_BROKERS don't need it installed.
proof: Import app.brokers without ib_async installed; no ImportError until get_broker('ibkr') is used.

behavior: open_orders and cancel_order call reqAllOpenOrders first, so orders from other clientIds and from TWS itself are visible and cancellable.
proof: Place an order with clientId 2; clientId 1 open_orders lists it.

behavior: cancel_order on an unknown id logs a warning and returns None (no raise). cancel_all is reqGlobalCancel, which hits every order on the account, not just this client's.
proof: cancel_order('nope'); expect warning 'no open order with id nope'.

behavior: submit_order maps limit/stop/stop_limit only when the required prices are present; otherwise it silently sends a MARKET order. Always GTC. Returns None on any error.
proof: Submit order_type=stop with stop_price=None on paper; observe an MKT order.

behavior: Single-leg options need expiration, strike, and option_type; option_type accepts only call/put/C/P (validated since 10d5303). Expiry dashes are stripped; exchange defaults to SMART, currency to USD.
session_trades only covers orders this clientId's session has seen (resets on reconnect); executions() covers the whole day via reqExecutions.
proof: Reconnect; order-funnel counts reset while executions persist.

behavior: The IBKR client has no tests on main; its tests were deleted in the suite trim.
proof: git grep -li ibkr origin/main -- tests -> empty

behavior: cancel_all sends reqGlobalCancel, which cancels every open order on the account (all clientIds and TWS). It is reachable through unauthenticated /api/trade/cancel-all/ibkr once the leg is enabled (see robinhood.jsonl rh-api-trade-unauthenticated).
